preconditions.description: The initial number of heads Gorynych the Dragon has is between 0 and 200.
The initial number of tails Gorynych the Dragon has is between 0 and 200.
The sum of the initial number of heads and tails is less than R.
The number of pairs representing the number of heads and tails that grow when heads are cut is between 1 and 200.
The number of pairs representing the number of heads and tails that grow when tails are cut is between 1 and 200.

postconditions.description: The output is one of 'Ivan', 'Zmey', or 'Draw' indicating the outcome of the battle.
If Ivan wins, the number of blows he makes is between 1 and the sum of the initial number of heads and tails.
If Gorynych wins, the output is 'Zmey' and Ivan cannot win.
If the battle continues forever, the output is 'Draw' and neither Ivan nor Gorynych can win.

invariants.description: The battle continues until either Ivan wins, Gorynych wins, or they continue fighting forever.
